engine.win_condition: Attack with high-toughness creatures (primarily defenders and walls) that deal combat damage equal to their toughness via Felothar's ability and Assault Formation, turning defensive creatures into powerful threats.

Control the game through dense countermagic, drawing cards off Baral's cost reduction and counter-draw trigger. Win via Hullbreaker Horror + Sol Ring infinite mana into storm, Thassa's Oracle deck-out, or token beats from Talrand/Murmuring Mystic.

Generate card advantage through Kadena's draw trigger on face-down creature ETBs, accrue value from morphing creatures for effects, then overwhelm opponents through accumulated tempo and creature beats. Overwhelming Stampede and mass morph effects like Ixidron close out games.
Deal combat damage with evasive creatures to trigger Gonti's exile ability and theft effects, then cast opponents' best spells at a discount to accumulate overwhelming value advantage.

Tutor for and resolve Thassa's Oracle with Demonic Consultation or Tainted Pact to exile the library and win immediately. Backup lines include Underworld Breach with Lion's Eye Diamond and wheel effects to generate infinite storm and mill opponents with Brain Freeze.

Use K'rrik to pay life instead of mana to rapidly assemble game-winning combos: Bolas's Citadel + Sensei's Divining Top + Aetherflux Reservoir for infinite damage, Peer into the Abyss + Sheoldred to kill an opponent instantly, or Chainer + Gray Merchant loops for infinite drain.

Chain enchantments for card advantage via Tuvasa's draw trigger and enchantress payoffs (Enchantress's Presence, Eidolon of Blossoms, Sythis), then win through Tuvasa commander damage (scaled by enchantment count) or token generation from Sigil of the Empty Throne and Archon of Sun's Grace.

Generate infinite mana via Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter, Power Artifact + Basalt Monolith or Grim Monolith, or Emry loops, then win through Urza's activated ability, Thassa's Oracle, or Walking Ballista.

Generate large amounts of mana through ritual effects and Ozai's mana retention, then win via big burn spells (Torment of Hailfire, Exsanguinate, Crackle with Power) amplified by damage multipliers (Fiery Emancipation, Torbran). Aggravated Assault combo provides an alternate win line.

Cast noncreature spells to trigger Sokka's ability, creating a swarm of 1/1 Ally tokens. Each spell also triggers prowess on all Allies, growing the board. Win through combat damage with a wide army of buffed Ally creatures.

Kill opponents through repeated death and sacrifice drain triggers. Shelob creates Food token copies of creatures killed by Spiders in combat, then sacrifice those Food tokens to trigger drain effects from Mirkwood Bats, Marionette Master, and Disciple of the Vault while generating value through Pitiless Plunderer and Grave Pact effects.

Cast noncreature spells to trigger the commanders' combat abilities, then win through combat damage amplified by Human Torch's spreading damage, The Thing's counter-doubling, Mister Fantastic's ability copying, and Invisible Woman's evasion.
Draw cards with Welcoming Vampire whenever small creatures enter, generate value with evasive threats, and control the board with Hullbreaker Horror bounces. Win through evasive creature damage.

Repeatedly play lands from graveyard via Szarel and recursion effects to trigger landfall payoffs, winning through overwhelming board presence from Scute Swarm and Avenger of Zendikar tokens, plus direct damage from Omnath, Locus of Rage and Ob Nixilis, the Fallen.

Force opponents to attack each other through goad effects (Nelly, Disrupt Decorum, Vengeful Ancestor), draw cards from the resulting combat, protect yourself with pillowfort effects (Ghostly Prison, Windborn Muse), and win through card advantage and value creatures.

Generate card advantage for all players through Ms. Bumbleflower and group-hug effects, then convert the resulting draw into wins via Triskaidekaphile (13+ cards), Psychosis Crawler (drawing = damage), or Simic Ascendancy (20+ counters).

Generate card and life advantage by donating permanents to opponents via Zedruu's activated ability (pillowfort effects, group hug pieces), gaining life and cards each upkeep. Protect with pillowfort effects while accumulating resources, then win through Insurrection to steal all boards or overwhelming card advantage.
